cases.mechanism_detail: AluY inserted into the canonical AG of the intron 14 (10c) 3' splice site, causing in-frame skipping of exon 15 (11) (r.1642_1721del).
cases.quote: Disruption of these splice sites readily explains the observed skipping of the downstream exons (type 1 splicing effect in Figure 3).

cases.mechanism_detail: AluY inserted in the polypyrimidine tract of the intron 10 (8) 3' splice site together with a 71-bp deletion (no TSD), causing in-frame skipping of exon 11 (9) (r.1186_1260del).
cases.quote: Disruption of these splice sites readily explains the observed skipping of the downstream exons (type 1 splicing effect in Figure 3).

cases.mechanism_detail: AluYa5 (~60-bp polyA) inserted in exon 6 (4c) causes in-frame skipping of the exon (r.587_654del).
cases.quote: Skipping of the affected exon was also observed in five other patients with Alu insertions, i.e. two insertions at the identical site in exon 33 (25), two insertions at different integration sites in exon 22 (17) and one insertion in exon 6 (4c) (type 2 effect in Figure 3).

cases.mechanism_detail: AluYa5 inserted at c.2835_2836 in exon 21 (16) activates a cryptic 5' splice site upstream of the insertion, deleting the last 233 nt of the exon (r.2618_2850del). Same site was hit independently in UAB-R37616; one of the two was proven de novo.
cases.quote: This partial exon skipping results from the use of a cryptic 5′ splice site located upstream of the integration site (type 3 effect in Figure 3).

cases.mechanism_detail: Independent AluYa5 at the same c.2835_2836 site in exon 21 (16) (different TSD) activates a cryptic 5' splice site, deleting the last 233 nt of the exon (r.2618_2850del). One of the two exon 21 patients was proven de novo.
cases.quote: This partial exon skipping results from the use of a cryptic 5′ splice site located upstream of the integration site (type 3 effect in Figure 3).

cases.mechanism_detail: AluYa5 inserted near the start of exon 22 (17) causes out-of-frame skipping of exon 22 (r.2851_2990del).
cases.quote: Skipping of the affected exon was also observed in five other patients with Alu insertions, i.e. two insertions at the identical site in exon 33 (25), two insertions at different integration sites in exon 22 (17) and one insertion in exon 6 (4c) (type 2 effect in Figure 3).

cases.mechanism_detail: AluYa5 inserted at c.4319_4320 in exon 33 (25) causes out-of-frame skipping of exon 33 (r.4270_4367del); same site independently hit by an AluYb8 in UAB-R340101.
cases.quote: Skipping of the affected exon was also observed in five other patients with Alu insertions, i.e. two insertions at the identical site in exon 33 (25), two insertions at different integration sites in exon 22 (17) and one insertion in exon 6 (4c) (type 2 effect in Figure 3).

cases.mechanism_detail: 5'-truncated AluYa5 in exon 47 (38) causes both in-frame skipping of the exon and use of an exonic cryptic 5' splice site upstream of the insertion (loss of last 62 nt).
cases.quote: Insertion of an AluYa5 element into exon 47 (38) resulted in at least two different splicing effects, i.e. skipping of the exon and use of an exonic cryptic 5′ splice site upstream of the integration site (mutation MUI-2; type 2 and 3 splicing effect in Figure 3; see also Figure S1).

cases.mechanism_detail: A cryptic 5' splice site inside the 5'-truncated AluYb8 in exon 12 (10a) is used, so transcripts contain the first 61 nt of the Alu and lack the last 38 nt of exon 12 (r.1355_1392delins61).
cases.quote: A cryptic 5′ splice site within this truncated Alu element is used instead of the natural one of the exon 12 (10a), leading to transcripts containing the first 61 nucleotides of this Alu element but lacking the 3′ half of exon 12 (10a), downstream of the Alu integration site (type 5 effect in Figure 3).

cases.mechanism_detail: AluYb8 inserted in the polypyrimidine tract of the intron 14 (10c) 3' splice site causes skipping of exon 15 (11) (r.1642_1721del, out of frame).
cases.quote: Disruption of these splice sites readily explains the observed skipping of the downstream exons (type 1 splicing effect in Figure 3).

cases.mechanism_detail: AluYb8 inserted 30 nt into exon 21 (16) leads to use of a cryptic 3' splice site downstream of the insertion and loss of the first 229 nt of the exon (r.2410_2638del).
cases.quote: Similarly, integration of an AluYb8 element at position c.2439_2440 in the 5′ half of exon 21 (16), 30 nucleotides downstream of the intron-exon 21 (16) border, resulted in the use of a cryptic 3′ splice site downstream of the integration site and loss of the first 229 bp of the exon 21 (16) (mutation UAB-R39428 in Table 1; type 4 effect in Figure 3).

cases.mechanism_detail: AluYb8 inserted in exon 22 (17) causes out-of-frame skipping of exon 22 (r.2851_2990del).
cases.quote: Skipping of the affected exon was also observed in five other patients with Alu insertions, i.e. two insertions at the identical site in exon 33 (25), two insertions at different integration sites in exon 22 (17) and one insertion in exon 6 (4c) (type 2 effect in Figure 3).

cases.mechanism_detail: AluYb8 at the same c.4319_4320 site in exon 33 (25) as UAB-R81017 causes out-of-frame skipping of exon 33 (r.4270_4367del).
cases.quote: Skipping of the affected exon was also observed in five other patients with Alu insertions, i.e. two insertions at the identical site in exon 33 (25), two insertions at different integration sites in exon 22 (17) and one insertion in exon 6 (4c) (type 2 effect in Figure 3).

cases.mechanism_detail: 5'-truncated AluYb8 inserted in the polypyrimidine tract of the intron 48 (39) 3' splice site causes in-frame skipping of exon 49 (40) (r.7127_7258del).
cases.quote: Disruption of these splice sites readily explains the observed skipping of the downstream exons (type 1 splicing effect in Figure 3).

cases.mechanism_detail: A ~120-bp poly(T) stretch (no recognisable element) inserted 3 nt before the end of exon 25 (19b) activates a cryptic 5' splice site, deleting the last 40 nt of the exon (r.3275_3314del).
cases.quote: Insertion of the approximately 120-bp poly(T) stretch at c.3312_3313 in exon 25 (19b), 3 nucleotides upstream of the exon-intron border also led to use of a cryptic 5′ splice site and loss of the last 40 nucleotides of this exon (mutation UAB-R75103; type 3 effect in Figure 3).

cases.mechanism_detail: 5'-truncated L1 (pre-Ta; 1753 bp of ORF2 plus polyA, preceded by 8 extra nt) inserted in exon 23 (18) causes in-frame skipping of the exon (r.2991_3113del).
cases.quote: Insertion of the 5′-truncated L1 element into exon 23 (18) also caused simple exon skipping in the transcripts of the patient UAB-R316001 (type 2 splicing effect in Figure 3).

cases.mechanism_detail: Full-length 6-kb L1 (Ta-1d) in exon 39 (30): a 5' splice site within the L1 replaces the natural one, so transcripts lack the last 143 nt of the exon and contain the first 96 nt of L1 (r.5607_5749delins96).
cases.quote: Finally, a 5′ splice site within the full-length L1 element inserted into exon 39 (30) is used instead of the natural 5′ splice site of exon 39 (30), leading to a transcript lacking the 143 nucleotides of the exon downstream of the integration site and containing instead the first 96 nucleotides of the L1 element (patient UAB-R01429; type 5 effect in Figure 3).

cases.mechanism_detail: 5'-inverted, truncated L1 (~2.2 kb, ORF2 fragment) inserted 195 nt into intron 9 (7) causes skipping of exon 9 (7) and inclusion of a 130-bp cryptic exon from the L1 (r.889_1062delins130). Orientation is given as sense in the text but antisense in Table 1/2.
cases.quote: The insertion of the 5′-inverted L1 element 195 nucleotides downstream of exon 9 (7) caused skipping of exon 9 (7) as well as inclusion of a 130-bp cryptic exon embedded within the inserted L1 element (patient UAB-R91409; type 6 effect in Figure 3; see also Figure S6).
